messages:
deploy-bot: wave-zero deploy to us-east started (commit e3a4f9). canary tasks spinning up, healthchecks enabled.

sam-oncall: getting pager: elevated 5xx from canary group 2 in us-east-1a :rotating_light:

carla-sre: looking — probes returning 502 from frontend->inference path, kv-cache miss rate spiked ~x12. not seeing model OOMs.

michael-platform: infra telemetry: egress DNS errors in us-east-1a around 2023-07-15T14:02Z. some hosts failing to reach external cert service.

sam-oncall: pausing traffic shift, recommending abort for wave-zero until infra stabilizes. can someone flip the canary flag?

alice-dev: on it — what's the command?

sam-oncall: run: `/feature-flag set canary_wave_zero enabled false`

ops-runner: ran the toggle, API returned 200, confirmed no new canary allocations for wave-zero :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: traffic shift paused, autopromote disabled for wave-zero.

carla-sre: quick customer-impact check: 5xx spike localized to us-east; global 5xx delta +0.45% (baseline 0.03%). small but noticeable for some high-throughput tenants.

michael-platform: starting host drain for affected AZ and rebalancing to other healthy nodes in the region. will post progress.

sam-oncall: creating short incident ticket and tagging oncall handoff at +15m if not cleared. if 5xx persists after drains we'll escalate to SEV.

alice-dev: collecting a sample of failed request ids and a few kvcache traces, uploading to the incident doc.

ops-runner: drain initiated (IDs: host-ux34, host-ux37). first host removed from LB in 45s.

carla-sre: request-log snippet pasted to thread: ```
[2023-07-15T14:02:12Z] req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate upstream=frontend->inference status=502 backend_err=ECONNRESET kvcache_miss=1
```

sam-oncall: thanks. if infra confirms DNS/audit fix, we can retry a tiny traffic wedge later. for now keep the wave flagged off.

deploy-bot: note: wave-zero canary autopromote remains disabled until manual clear.

michael-platform: DNS cache flush pushed to affected nodes, monitoring 1min. will report after 2 cycles.

sam-oncall: handoff plan: if no new 5xx in 10m and drains healthy, ops/infra will try a controlled 1% wedge and monitor. if anything >0.2% above baseline -> abort and revert. otherwise we'll continue. assigning follow-up to @carla-sre and @michael-platform.

ops-runner: acknowledged, monitoring dashboards up (latency, 5xx by AZ, kvcache miss). will page if slope increases. :mag_right:

carla-sre: bookmarking incident doc and adding a postmortem stub. tagging impacted customers for potential outreach.

sam-oncall: closing temp loop here — keep updates in this thread. handoff to next oncall in 12m if still active. :thumbsup:
